polishes.name: Amber Resin Nail
polishes.description: DESCRIPTIONAmber Resin: A shimmering copper magnetic that pulls to reveal an earthen red crelly base. Inspired by amber which is an ancient form of fossilized tree sap. Although not used as a colouring agent itself, amber resin can be dissolved in oil paints to enhance the finish and colour brilliance. And of course, human use of "amber" as a colour descriptor comes from this ancient substance. Includes: A single nail polish bottle, housed in a cardboard box. Application Tips: We recommend applying two coats and magnetizing the third for full opacity. Our favourite methods are cat-eye or a "lazy gradient" by pushing the pigment away from half of your nail (in an orientation you desire such as towards the tip for a faux French magnetic manicure). These polishes also look beautiful un-magnetized as bright jewel-toned metallics! A downloadable application guide for magnetic polishes can be found here. Shake well before use. COLLECTIONOur new Saturated Slick formula was inspired by colourants and pigments of the natural world. Long before technology existed to create synthetic options, humans would use what Mother Nature had to offer. From sticky saps to minerals, colouring agents were found from many sources. polishes.name: Astro Fuzz Nail
polishes.description: DESCRIPTIONAstro Fuzz: A cosmic magnetic nail lacquer with a duality to its pull. This polish has interwoven shifts of pink/yellow and teal/red that magnetize to reveal a static night sky scattered with reflective micro-glitter and holographic micro-flakes to create the ultimate dimensionality. Includes: A single nail polish bottle, housed in a cardboard box. Application Tips: Best applied in 2 coats, then magnetize the third. Due to the interwoven, dual magnetic pull, we find the best way to enhance this effect is by magnetizing in the velvet style, or a "lazy gradient" by pushing the pigment away from half of your nail (in an orientation you desire such as towards the tip for a faux French magnetic manicure). Of course, a cat eye magnetization will look equally as beautiful and lend more towards a cosmic effect. A downloadable application guide for magnetic polishes can be found here. Shake well before use. COLLECTIONOur new Static formula from the Slick-adelic Collection is other-worldly. A fusion of a static inspired aesthetic imparted by reflective glitters and ultra-dimensional cosmic inspired skies a kin to our past Spacetime Slicks. This formula will take you to a whole new universe of magnetic polish! Our favourite methods are cat-eye or a "lazy gradient" by pushing the pigment away from half of your nail (in an orientation you desire such as towards the tip for a faux French magnetic manicure). COLLECTIONOur new Saturated Slick formula was inspired by colourants and pigments of the natural world. Long before technology existed to create synthetic options, humans would use what Mother Nature had to offer. From sticky saps to minerals, colouring agents were found from many sources. polishes.name: Cirrus | Cloud Crelly Nail
polishes.description: Check out the On Topper the World Collection Launch Video for a full look at the collection. DESCRIPTIONCirrus: A pastel purple crelly with a wispy cloud-like finish. Our Cloud Crellies are a hybrid between a jelly and crème; they have a sheer, buildable and self-levelling formula. Because of the small amount of white pigment in them, they have a more pastelized hue and slightly more opaque finish compared to a jelly formula. Includes: A single nail polish bottle, housed in a cardboard box. Application Tips: Use 2-3 coats to achieve desired finish. We recommend using a base and top coat to increase manicure longevity and add the finish you desire (glossy or matte top coat). Shake well before use. Swatches show both the jelly and corresponding crelly from the On Topper the World Collection. Polishes have been applied in 2 (index and ring) and 3 (middle and pinky) coats. COLLECTIONThe On Topper the World Collection emulates the surreal beauty of being above the clouds, literally and figuratively. Imagine radiant skies with a sun-streaked horizon as you soar above the clouds with a weightless happiness. This collection brings you The On Topper the World Eyeshadow Palette with a 22 piece collection of nail lacquers inspired by that dreamy, elevated feeling of joy, calmness and a luminous sense of self. polishes.name: Galápagos Archipelago Palette
polishes.collection: They are the same as our Stained Glass
polishes.description: GALAPAGOS ARCHIPELAGO PALETTEInspired by the breathtaking beauty of the Galápagos Islands, this six-pan palette captures the wonder of one of the world’s most extraordinary ecosystems. Featuring imagery of the iconic Bartolomé Island alongside wildlife photography taken during our own journey through the archipelago, every detail celebrates the islands that inspired it. Inside are six full-sized specialty eyeshadows, each showcasing Clionadh’s signature multichromatic formulas. These shades reflect the remarkable wildlife and landscapes that make the Galápagos one of the most unique biodiversity regions of the world. Our talc and filler-free formula delivers luxurious quality products with a high concentration of pigments. Proudly handmade in Canada. SHADOWSSally Lightfoot Crab: A multidimensional shadow with a soft grey base that shifts magenta-red-orange-yellow with hints of lime and indigo sparkles. Medium particle size. Approved for use on face, eyes and body (Canada & EU), and face, body (USA)**.Hammerhead Shark: A multidimensional shadow with a murky, mustard yellow base and an ultraviolet shift interwoven with silver and mint sparkles. Approved for use on face, eyes and body (Canada, EU & USA).Giant Tortoise: A multidimensional shadow with a red/brown base that shifts green-beige-pink with interwoven multicoloured sparkles. Approved for use on face, eyes and body (Canada & EU), and face, body (USA)**.Galápagos Penguin: An iridescent shadow that shifts yellow-green-aqua. Small particle size. Approved for use on face, eyes and body. (Canada, EU & USA)Land Iguana: A multidimensional shadow with a grungy, yellow base that shifts peach-yellow-lime with interwoven blue sparkles. Approved for use on face, eyes and body (Canada, EU & USA).Blue-Footed Booby: An ocean blue based shadow with sparkling violet-pink-pale yellow shift. Medium/large particle size. Please note: During the drying process, a thin layer of the blue pigment can settle at the surface, causing the shadow to appear deeper blue than it is. This is completely normal and will swipe away after a few uses. (Canada, EU & USA) This palette features magnetic wells, allowing for the pans to be removed. They are the same as our Stained Glass Collection pans and can be interchanged, if desired. Weight: 6 x 1.5 g, (NET WT. 9 g)Details: Vegan, Cruelty-free, Paraben-free, and Talc-free Please note: Our packaging always reflects the guaranteed minimum product weight you will receive. Due to differences in pigment densities and the hand poured nature of our products, shadows vary in weight. We guarantee 1.5 grams per pan, though they can be up to 2.5 grams with an average of 2 grams. Safeties of Use: Please refer to each shadow for individual intended use within Canada, EU and USA. ** = Not intended for use on immediate eye area. For all other regions, please refer to the ingredients and your country's cosmetic regulations. polishes.name: Planetary Attraction Nail
polishes.description: DESCRIPTIONPlanetary Attraction: A cosmic magnetic nail lacquer with a subtle duality to its pull. This polish has interwoven shifts of grungy lime/teal and green/indigo that magnetize to reveal a static night sky scattered with reflective micro-glitter and holographic micro-flakes to create the ultimate dimensionality. Includes: A single nail polish bottle, housed in a cardboard box. Application Tips: Best applied in 2 coats, then magnetize the third. Due to the interwoven, dual magnetic pull, we find the best way to enhance this effect is by magnetizing in the velvet style, or a "lazy gradient" by pushing the pigment away from half of your nail (in an orientation you desire such as towards the tip for a faux French magnetic manicure). Of course, a cat eye magnetization will look equally as beautiful and lend more towards a cosmic effect. A downloadable application guide for magnetic polishes can be found here. Shake well before use. COLLECTIONOur new Static formula from the Slick-adelic Collection is other-worldly. A fusion of a static inspired aesthetic imparted by reflective glitters and ultra-dimensional cosmic inspired skies a kin to our past Spacetime Slicks. This formula will take you to a whole new universe of magnetic polish! polishes.name: Sangre De Drago Nail
polishes.description: DESCRIPTIONSangre de Drago: A shimmering red magnetic that pulls to reveal a deep maroon base. Inspired by the sap of the Dragon's Blood tree, more commonly known as "Sangre de Drago" in South America where the tree is native to the Amazon. To this day, the sap is sometimes still used in varnishes. Includes: A single nail polish bottle, housed in a cardboard box. Application Tips: We recommend applying two coats and magnetizing the third for full opacity. Our favourite methods are cat-eye or a "lazy gradient" by pushing the pigment away from half of your nail (in an orientation you desire such as towards the tip for a faux French magnetic manicure). These polishes also look beautiful un-magnetized as bright jewel-toned metallics! A downloadable application guide for magnetic polishes can be found here. Shake well before use. COLLECTIONOur new Saturated Slick formula was inspired by colourants and pigments of the natural world. Long before technology existed to create synthetic options, humans would use what Mother Nature had to offer. From sticky saps to minerals, colouring agents were found from many sources. polishes.name: Static Stardust Nail
polishes.description: DESCRIPTIONStatic Stardust: A cosmic magnetic nail lacquer with a duality to its pull. This polish has interwoven shifts of magenta/orange and pewter/lime that magnetize to reveal a static night sky scattered with reflective micro-glitter and holographic micro-flakes to create the ultimate dimensionality. Includes: A single nail polish bottle, housed in a cardboard box. Application Tips: Best applied in 2 coats, then magnetize the third. Due to the interwoven, dual magnetic pull, we find the best way to enhance this effect is by magnetizing in the velvet style, or a "lazy gradient" by pushing the pigment away from half of your nail (in an orientation you desire such as towards the tip for a faux French magnetic manicure). Of course, a cat eye magnetization will look equally as beautiful and lend more towards a cosmic effect. A downloadable application guide for magnetic polishes can be found here. Shake well before use. COLLECTIONOur new Static formula from the Slick-adelic Collection is other-worldly. A fusion of a static inspired aesthetic imparted by reflective glitters and ultra-dimensional cosmic inspired skies a kin to our past Spacetime Slicks. This formula will take you to a whole new universe of magnetic polish!
